sn35.26:1.1: Sabbam bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhavyāya || || 3
sn35.26:1.2: Kiñca bhikkhave sabbam anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || 4-6
sn35.26:1.3: Cakkhum bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya ||
sn35.26:1.4: rūpe anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya ||
sn35.26:1.7: Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassa || la || dukkhakkhayāya || || pe || || 7-8
sn35.26:1.8: Jivham anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya ||
sn35.26:1.12: Yam pidam jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukham vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || ||
sn35.26:1.14: Manam anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya ||
sn35.26:1.18: yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || 10
sn35.26:1.19: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave sabbam anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya || || 11
